items.name: utils
items.title: cn
items.description: Class name merger — clsx piped through tailwind-merge.

items.name: brand-theme
items.title: Brand Theme
items.description: The --brand token the fields paint their focus, error and accent states with.

items.name: field-hint
items.title: Field Hint
items.description: Explanatory panel anchored to a field's trailing info mark. Built on Tooltip so it never steals focus from the field that opened it.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text field with an optional leading icon and a focus-driven hint panel.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Single-choice dropdown over a string list, with the same icon and hint affordances as Input.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button with variant, size and shape sets built on class-variance-authority.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip primitives — provider, root, trigger and content.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Progress rail for multi-step flows: a mobile progress bar plus a clickable desktop rail.

items.name: stepper-provider
items.title: Stepper Provider
items.description: Step state behind a context — current index, next/back guards and a useStepper hook — plus the view that renders the rail and the active step.

items.name: step-field
items.title: Step Field
items.description: Label, control and validation message. Layout only — it holds no form state.

items.name: form-fields
items.title: Form Fields
items.description: FormInput and FormSelect bound to react-hook-form through useController, so a field's error re-renders that field alone.

items.name: normalize
items.title: normalize
items.description: Input normalisers — currently `digits`, which strips everything that is not a digit.

items.name: tckn
items.title: T.C. Kimlik No
items.description: Validates a Turkish national identity number, check digits included — which is what stops a typo from passing as a real identity.

items.name: quote-schema
items.title: Quote Schema
items.description: Zod schemas for the quote flow — TCKN, Turkish mobile number, e-mail and occupation — plus per-step field lists and form defaults.
